steps.text: Rhodes Island Landship
Astesia's Room

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Rubs eyes)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: If I recall correctly...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: According to the books, the constellations should be stable and distinct tonight.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Hopefully it'll be a fruitful... night...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Rubs eyes subconsciously)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: My recent calculations have deviated greatly from the data published by the Astrology Society.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Father must be displeased...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I should wait a while before sending my response to him.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oripathy... Oripathy...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Rubs eyes subconsciously)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll make a few more notes tonight. If the projections are still off, we'll need to get the right data from observation.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Lightly rubs eyes)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: *Yawn*...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: My eyes itch...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Hey Sia, I'm here.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mm. Good mor—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: What's going on with your eyes?!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: My eyes? They're just a little itchy.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: They're completely bloodshot!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: They'll get better soon...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: There are even lumps...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: This isn't something that recovers on its own.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll take you to Medical.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: But tonight—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Forget about the stars. The stars won't heal your eyes.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: W-Wait...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Bacterial infection. Acute inflammation in both eyes with pus formation.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Perfectly treatable. Just a minor surgery and some medication, and you'll be good as new in a couple of days.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But you won't be able to see for 36 hours. You should arrange to stay the night here.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Can we delay the surgery?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll make the call, doctor.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Well, the two of you can work it out amongst yourselves.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Genne...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: The answer is no.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I know why you wanted to put it off, and I know how much this means to you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: But let me say it again.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: The answer is no.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You know what I care about more than anything.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: She's agreed to the surgery.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I need to hear it from you directly, Operator Astesia.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) Yeah...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Then I'll need the signature of a family member for this informed consent form.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: (Reads and signs the form)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Takes the form and enters data into a terminal)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Go reserve a bed at the front desk. You'll be taken to the ward directly after surgery. Family members can wait there.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Follow me, Operator Astesia.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Relax. It's a simple operation.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: As we told you earlier, you'll be under general anesthesia for the surgery. Is that okay?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Administers anesthetic)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Count from one to ten.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: One.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Two.
After an indeterminate period of time...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Can you speak?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Move your finger if you hear me.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Slight finger wag)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The patient is awake.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The operation went well. The nurses will take you to your ward in a bit, and I'll stop by on my nightly rounds.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let me know if you feel any discomfort.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Nod if you hear me.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Nods with effort)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good.
The doctor's footsteps fade away. The bed is laid flat and pushed into the corridor.
The wheels make a screeching sound as they touch the ground.
Even noisier, however, are the complaints of doctors, patients, and accompanying personnel.
Just be patient, Popukar. It'll be your turn soon.
Why are there so many sick people today? Who's next?!
I already paid! What's—I have to sign an agreement? Fine, fine, bring it on, my sister's waiting for me on her bed.
How was I supposed to know I'd be allergic to this nail polish? Ow... it itches...
Voices come from all directions, carrying emotions that not even the speakers are aware of.
Sadness, regret, fear; Astesia hears all of it.
She feels uneasy.
Normally, she would be the one to comfort these people in distress.
Right now, however, she is the one lying on a hospital bed.
The bed stops in the corridor, turns, and enters a ward.
Medics secure the bed and give the usual inpatient briefing.
Once satisfied that their patient is doing fine, they leave briskly.
The voices from the Medical Department leave Astesia's head as soon as the door closes.
It is silent.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Genne...
As the effects of the anesthetic wear off, she begins calling for her younger sister.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Genne... are you there?
No one responds.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Anyone?
There is nothing here but her own voice.
She feels a sense of helplessness.
She used to be an astrologer guiding the paths of many.
Right now, however, she can neither reveal the path for someone else, nor see that of her own.
Ever since the Originium took root in her body...
The stars are silent.
She remembers that some of the most famous astromancers never tried to hide the fact that they were Infected.
She remembers the look on her father's face when he learned of her infection.
Concern, mingled with joy.
Which is why he could not hide his disappointment when he learned that infection had not made his daughter a great astromancer; far from it, in fact.
Perhaps the stars forsook her for her cowardice, as she cowered in the safehouse while her sister faced the lab's Originium leak on her own.
The stars rescinded their mercy, leaving behind only the cold glint of Originium.
So shiny, it pierces the heart.
(Whispers) Sia...
(Whispers) Are you alright?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: ...Genne?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Yeah, I'm here.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It was such a pain trying to get a quiet single room for you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: A single room... you're wasting money again.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Not really, I just diverted a bit of equipment funding.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: What's the matter? Your palms are sweaty.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No... I'm fine...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Do your eyes feel any better?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: They don't itch anymore. Dr. Folinic did a great job.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: And to think you're the one who was always telling me to go to bed and get up early.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Still thinking about stargazing tonight?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The conditions are the best they've been for months.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll tell the doctor to tie you to the bed if you so much as try to take those bandages off.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I won't. I'm just thinking about it.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: My eyes are more important. I'll listen to you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Hm... alright, fine then.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Not that Dad would appreciate the results anyway.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: How did you—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I looked at your observation logs and conclusions. They're very different from the Society's.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I caught a glimpse while looking for your ID.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You left them on the desk.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Ever since then, not once have I been able to provide Father and the Society with the right data. Of course he would be angry with me...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Actually, I made some calculations based on that data of yours.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You were right. Always were.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You don't need to comfort me.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I know what I'm doing. I never liked stargazing, but I DID have a formal education in it forced down my throat.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: What's right is right, and what's wrong is wrong. I don't need to lie to you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I can present the steps and possibility spaces in data models for you, if you like. After your eyes have healed.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Are you suggesting that the Society's data is wrong?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Yeesh, did you really have to inherit Dad's hard head too?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Have you ever considered that you could both be correct?

spans.text: Have you ever considered that you could

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It's not exactly unusual in science.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Data can be affected by external factors. Rhodes Island isn't in Columbia. The observation environment and geographic location are completely different.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: The stars don't move in regular ways, either. Frankly, I'd be more shocked if your results were exactly the same.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: But the algorithm has already been adjusted for position!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Take it easy, Sia.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: That's why I said your data is right.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I picked up Dad's methods faster than you, but your results were always way more accurate.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It's high time you accepted that he's not always right. Don't just assume that you're wrong because they doubt you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: (Whisper) Not that I'm in a position to lecture anyone...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Ahem. Anyway, I'll help you out with it once you get better. We could even go home and confront Dad together, if we have to. How's that?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Let me hold your hand, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Oh, come on, how old are you? Here.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Holds her sister's hand gently)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: No need for that between sisters.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Don't overthink it. Just get some rest and heal up.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Anything you want to eat?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Drizzle cake—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Nut cookies and berry juice. Got it.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll make dinner. You've been the cook ever since I got here. You should try my cooking once in a while.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll get to it, then.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: (Gently moves her sister's hand)

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I left some cut fruit on the table to your left. There's a toothpick in each piece. Just put them back on the plate when you're done.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: And here—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Your astrolabe's to the right of your pillow.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: That should be all.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'll be going, then. Take care.
The door closes again, leaving Astesia by herself once more.
The world is still dark, but the darkness does not feel so oppressive this time, with the astrolabe's gentle clockwork humming by her side.
Her sister's encouragement has helped her reassess her situation.
Is she independent?
No, not compared to Astgenne.
Her sister continues to break new ground, striving for the lifestyle she wants. Meanwhile, she herself lacks the courage to even rebut her father's doubts.
Astrology is a school of tradition. It is not as systematic as modern science, but it is old, and with age comes authority.
She realized at an early age that her explorations and questions would be shot down by her teachers, or given an established answer. And she would accept it, even if she did not agree.
No mistakes were made, therefore they must be right.
She is afraid of being denied by authority, and so she accepts their conclusions without question.
Then why did Oripathy break that barrier?
Is it because she encountered the dilemma of either denying authority or denying self?
Or did her sister's courage inspire her to face her longtime doubts?
Astesia does not yet have the answer.
Other than preparing meals, Astgenne spends the rest of the day by Astesia's side, making life stuck in a hospital bed more bearable.
Astgenne wanted to stay by her sister's side as night fell too, but Astesia persuaded her to return to her own quarters.
She knows that bright stars fill the sky above Rhodes Island as it travels.
She has seen that sight countless times, but continues to be fascinated by the uncertainty that lies within. She would gaze upon it forever, if she could, but right now—

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Was there something else, Genne?
It's me. I'm making my rounds.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oh, my apologies, Dr. Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How are your eyes feeling? Any itching, excessive tearing, or the sensation of heat or foreign objects?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No. The surgery went well.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Then you should recover soon.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You sound awfully tired.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm used to it. It's like this every day.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Feel free to have a seat then, if you're not busy.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: My sister cut me so much fruit that I can hardly finish all of it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's almost time for lights-out. You're the last patient tonight.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I think I can stay... fifteen minutes.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor. There should be a chair by my bed.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Astgenne has a knack for picking fruits.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: We've both always liked these.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Actually, I have something I wanted to ask, but I was afraid it might be offensive.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I don't meet many operators who work with divination or the occult.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: In my eyes, people like that seem like they're trying to pass themselves off as omniscient and omnipotent.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If you can really tell the future, why weren't you even able to avoid your own illness?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I've never once considered myself omniscient.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's just that I was born to a family of astrologers, so that's what I've studied since I was little.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You may find this sort of knowledge to be abstract and impractical, but if I want to help people, it's all I have.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: From the Columbian elites to the uneducated young men in the Pioneer teams, many encounter things that their own knowledge and experiences cannot explain.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: In such cases, they try to dispel their doubts through the supernatural. That's what I understand to be the reason for studying these matters.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: There are times when you have doubts yourself, aren't there, Dr. Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...You wouldn't understand.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Did you know that the brightest constellation in the sky tonight is the symbol of Ursus?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I don't know what pains you harbor, but I can surmise the reasons through unscientific means.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Not that I could comfort you, though. To you, it would seem nothing but meaningless derision.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Ha...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You would make a great psychiatrist, Astesia.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Even the best psychiatrist can't foretell an eye infection, after all.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Instead, it must be treated by someone with concrete knowledge, like you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's about time for me to head out.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rest well, Astesia. You should be able to see the light again by this time tomorrow.
The doctor turns off the lights before she leaves. Astesia falls asleep, dreaming of the starry sky.
She has loved the stars from a young age, just as her sister loved science.
For her, watching the skies is a habit born of both nature and nurture.
Which is why it hurt so much to be rejected and denied.
Not because she was rejected by authority, but because of the regret that she did not understand.
The more she studies this abstract wisdom, the smaller she feels.
Does the answer truly lie in the stars?
Astesia does not know the answer.
But there is one thing she knows.
A traveler who loses his way in the night gazes up towards the stars, his eternal companion, before continuing on his journey until he finds his way again.
Astesia wakes from her dream as the sun shines in, visible through her bandages and eyelids.
She is waiting for her sister.
With her help, she could at least get her teeth brushed, wipe the parts of her face not covered by bandages, and move around a little before lying down again.
She hears the long-awaited sound of the door.
But it is not Astgenne.
Are you ok, Astesia?!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Tomimi? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I came with Gavial. She told me that one of my friends got admitted yesterday, so I ran over right away.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Are you okay? That looks serious. Did you get hit in the eyes?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No, it was just an infection. It'll heal soon.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: By the way, could you tell me if there are toiletries by the bed? Toothbrush, towels, that sort of thing?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Gets up from the bed)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Then could you grab them for me and lead me to the bathroom?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Sure thing!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Take it nice and slow...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Toothbrush, toothpaste, and cup. Need me to squeeze the toothpaste for you too?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I can do that much myself. The towel, too.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alrighty then.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Squeezes out the toothpaste and begins brushing)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I just set up a couple of pedestals in my room so I could put stuff on them, but Gavial's eyes lit up when she saw them. She said they were really cool, like totems.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Mumbles)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, and I took my nursing test a while back.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I don't like tests, but now that I passed it, I can help Gavial with her medical work.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Nods while brushing)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And Bibeak started teaching me how to make clothes. Soon I'll be able to make beautiful clothes for everyone!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Why are you so quiet, Astesia?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Rinses mouth)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Don't worry, I was listening.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Washes towel)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You're doing wonderfully, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hehe, it's all thanks to your tips. I've been really thinking about what I want to do and what I can do.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What you want to do and what you can do... hmm.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Wipes face gently)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But all that good stuff has got me in trouble now.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Wrings the towel to dry it)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Would you mind helping me back to the bed? We can talk more once we're seated.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, sure.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Careful.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Watch your feet...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Have a seat.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm sitting.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: So, what sort of troubles are you having then?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Now I have to think about caring for my babies, helping out Gavial, making clothes with Bibeak, and everything else.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I just feel like I don't have time...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Are you... considering giving up on something?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah. Maybe there's just too much stuff I wanna do, and there are also tons of things I have to do here at Rhodes Island.

spans.text: Yeah. Maybe there's just too much stuff I wanna do, and there are also tons of things I
to do here at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Maybe the fun stuff will have to wait...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: And that upsets you.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, Astesia! Exactly!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But I'm not sure how I can balance everything...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's human nature to want to have your cake and eat it too. Once missed, some opportunities will never return. You shouldn't be too hard on yourself over it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Perhaps you're unaware, but time management is an entire field of its own.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I can't say I'm an expert in it myself, but I'll teach you what I know.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alright! Thank you so much!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is this part of astrology too?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Astrology? No.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The stars may show us the path, but they can't walk it for us.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: That requires self-determination, and no end of effort.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: But I think you can handle it. Can't you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Uh... Yeah!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Will you be visiting the bookstore tomorrow afternoon?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Then do wait for me there. We can talk once you've bought the magazine.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You should be going now; no doubt Gavial's been griping about where her aide went off to.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You think? Okay, later!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Thanks, Astesia!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Huh... was that a friend?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Have you washed your face yet?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mhm!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Even though you can't see?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I had someone to be my eyes for me.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Figures. It's only been a day, and there's already a line outside your door.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Well then, what do you want to eat today?
The sun has set, and after a long day Astgenne falls asleep by her sister's side.
Astesia enjoys the peace of the darkness as she awaits the light.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Ast—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) How are your eyes, Astesia?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Whispers) Feeling wonderful, thanks to you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) Then I'll be taking the bandages off now.
The doctor cuts away Astesia's blindfolds.
Then she wipes off the remaining ointment with a cotton swab.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) Congratulations on making a full recovery, Operator Astesia.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) I've dimmed the lights. You can turn them up again once your eyes adjust.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) Refrain from drinking, spicy foods, and strenuous activity.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) I've also prescribed you some eye drops. Your sister has the prescription.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Whispers) I appreciate it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) ...I'd also like to have a chat with you this weekend, if you have some free time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) I think I could use a shrink.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Whispers) Anytime. Have a pleasant evening, Dr. Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Whispers) You too.
The doctor leaves. Astesia slowly opens her eyes, and sees her sister sleeping by the bed, alongside her own notebooks on the stars.
She opens them. The writing on the last few pages resembles her own, but not quite. Astgenne had made detailed notes on the stars last night.
There were some mistakes in the markings, and some misspelled stars.
But what does it matter?
Astesia closes her eyes and gazes towards the night sky beyond the window.
There are no stars there. Even the moon has been obscured by the dark clouds, with not a single ray shining through.
But there are stars. There, in her own eyes.
They shimmer and shine.
